# [CS084] Template Injection (template-injection)

Template source text is built from untrusted data.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | HIGH |
| **Category** | Security |
| **CWE** | [CWE-1336](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/1336.html) |
| **OWASP** | A05:2025 |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | No |

## Why It Matters in Go

Template actions in the parsed text can call any exported method and field of the data passed to Execute, read other templates and, with text/template, write raw markup. html/template escapes values, not the template itself, so parsing untrusted text is unsafe with both packages. The taint engine reports untrusted data that reaches Template.Parse.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```go
func greet(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	tmpl, err := template.New("greet").Parse("<p>Hello " + r.FormValue("name") + "</p>")
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	_ = tmpl.Execute(w, user)
}
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```go
var greetPage = template.Must(template.New("greet").Parse("<p>Hello {{.}}</p>"))

func greet(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	_ = greetPage.Execute(w, r.FormValue("name"))
}
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [template-injection]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    template-injection: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore template-injection -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** template-injection
```
